description: KS's Weather Mood is the Echo's screensaver 6:30-8:00 (screensaver.schedule, set in KS). It draws its own clock and weather, so the corner widgets go off for those 90 minutes, and KS's At a glance row (today's BoM forecast, rain chance, rain mm, UV) comes on. The row is global with no HA switch, so it goes through rest_command.ks_bedroom_settings. Same as ks_kitchen_morning_widgets, which runs 5:30-8:00.
